BrochureContent.Content:
Team Myles O'Donoghue are delighted to present 29 Oakview Avenue, a well-proportioned three-bedroom semi-detached family home ideally positioned in the popular residential area of Hartstown, Dublin 15. The property benefits from a converted attic room and a concrete shed to the rear, providing additional versatile space and excellent storage.

The accommodation is bright and well laid out, offering a practical arrangement ideally suited to modern family living. The ground floor briefly comprises an entrance hall, a spacious living room to the front with an opening through to the dining room, and a separate kitchen to the rear. The kitchen is fitted with a range of worktops and incorporated units, providing ample storage and workspace.

Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, comprising two well-proportioned double bedrooms and a single bedroom. The family bathroom is fitted with a WC, wash hand basin and a white suite incorporating a bath with shower attachment. The attic has also been converted and is currently used as a versatile attic room, offering valuable additional space.

Externally, the property benefits from a rear garden with a concrete shed, providing excellent additional storage and making the rear garden a practical outdoor space for family use and entertaining.

Oakview Avenue is situated in the popular Hartstown area of Dublin 15, close to an excellent selection of local amenities including schools, shops, cafs, sporting facilities and parks. The property is also conveniently located within easy reach of Blanchardstown Centre, offering an extensive range of retail, leisure and dining facilities.

The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with regular bus services providing easy access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. The nearby N3 and M50 provide excellent connectivity to all parts of Dublin, Dublin Airport and beyond.
